technical_requirements: Scale: 100M-300M embeddings. Latency targets: retrieval P50 <50ms, end-to-end (retrieve+rerank) <200ms at baseline 100 QPS, spikes to 400 QPS. Reindexing: nightly delta ingestion (10-20% of index) + weekly full snapshot. Storage: vector store must support sharding and multi-region replication (EU residency). Reranking: cross-encoder on GPU for top-100 rerank; must sustain 150-200 rerank/sec for POC. Indexing pipeline: Kafka-based ingestion, idempotent upserts, connector to internal monorepo CI. Cost objective: < $0.005 per typical query (retrieve+rerank). Integrations: Okta SAML SSO, AWS KMS for envelope encryption, audit logs pushed to SIEM. Preferred ANN: HNSW for low-latency, evaluate IVF/PQ for cost/size tradeoffs. Caching: prefix-level and hot-shard caching to reduce hot-repo tail latency. Quantization: evaluate 8-bit and 4-bit options on Dedicated hardware for cost savings.
